scope: Miao Chapter 7 (pp. 193-230): the principle of optimality for the infinite-horizon Markov decision process (Lemma 7.1.1, Theorems 7.1.1-7.1.3, Corollary 7.1.1, the borrowing example, Example 7.1.1); bounded rewards (Theorems 7.2.1-7.2.2); optimal control (Theorems 7.3.1-7.3.5); unbounded rewards and weighted norms (Theorem 7.3.6, Examples 7.3.1-7.3.2); the maximum principle (Theorem 7.4.1); Euler equations and transversality (Theorems 7.5.1-7.5.2, Example 7.5.1); Exercises 1-8 and 10.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 7
